documented_claim: The yellow quarantine flag marks infected premises; the ordinance includes cholera. It is a warning marker, not a weapon.
presentation: When the existing canonical Cholera resolution wounds crew, retain the game's approved wounded kneeling pose. Do not emit bullets, weapon flashes, flying impact fragments or metal/body hit audio from the quarantine marker. This pose communicates the canonical wounded state; it is not a clinical reconstruction of symptoms.
scope: Presentation dispatch only. Preserve wound targets, timing, counts, rules, source IDs, and authoritative logs. No new crew geometry or animation.
